answer: Weakest link: stake can be borrowed, so a sybil cluster funds many identities. Defend by making stake non-transferable and time-locked per hardware root, then routing work through a shared garden of verifiable tasks where each identity’s score is earned only on the public terrace of completed jobs; a velvet audit layer randomly samples peers. Borrowed stake fails because rewards accrue to the audited worker, not the funder, and slashed stake burns the hardware-bound bond.
